text: Did aliens build this? Four places people still argue about.
Over 1,300 kilometers of lines and giant figures in the desert.
Drawn around 2,000 years ago, and some are only really seen from the air.
Stone blocks cut so precisely they're interchangeable, nearly 4,000 meters up.
Archaeologists still haven't identified the tools that made those perfect angles.
Lebanon's Baalbek, temple stones of 800 tons, and in the quarry one block of 1,650 tons.
The biggest ever cut. Don't look at me, I was on holiday.
And Egypt's Great Pyramid, 2.3 million blocks, aligned to true north almost perfectly,
For nearly 4,000 years, it was the tallest building on Earth.
Aliens, or ancient people far smarter than we give them credit for.
I'm just here for the pyramid selfie.
